Mussels play a major role in cleaning up our Bay, but a majority of those mussels are threatened or endangered. 

Hatcheries like the Joseph Manning Fish Hatchery are vital in restoring and conserving our freshwater mussel population, giving us a cleaner Bay to enjoy and share with the rest of the world.

posts.text:
With grocery prices rising and federal support for food assistance being pulled back, Marylanders should know we’re working to help them.

This summer, we’ve gotten Sun Bucks benefits to over 584K students, up from around 90K in 2023.

If you need support, check your eligibility: dhs.maryland.gov/sunbucks

posts.text:
Patriotism asks you to fight for values and an ideal. 

Nationalism asks you to fight for a person or group. 

There's a difference, and it matters.
posts.quote:
Patriotism asks you to fight for values and an ideal. 

Nationalism asks you to fight for a person or group. 

There's a difference, and it matters.

posts.text:
My grandfather gave me one last gift before he passed away: a Bible.

Inside, he wrote four words: "Have faith, not fear."

Fear is the accelerant of nationalism. Faith is the foundation of patriotism.

Let’s choose faith.
